# moldtraining.us

> moldtraining.us offers self-paced online mold training for property management teams and mold inspection professionals: a 2-hour Mold Prevention & Remediation Awareness course, a 4-hour Property Management Teams course, and a 6-hour IAC2-aligned Mold Inspector Certification. All courses are available in English and Spanish, are mobile-friendly, and issue a certificate of completion immediately. Courses align with Federal OSHA and EPA guidelines, and the inspector course aligns with IAC2 (International Association of Certified Indoor Air Consultants) Standards of Practice.

moldtraining.us is a subsidiary of Industrial Certified Training, LLC, and partners with HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC. Course formats beyond on-demand online (SCORM, virtual instructor-led, in-person) are available via hazwoper-osha.com.

## Courses

- [Mold Prevention & Remediation Awareness](https://moldtraining.us/#pricing): 2 hours, $59.99/seat. Awareness-level course for general staff — mold basics, health effects and warning signs, common moisture sources, basic prevention habits, and when to escalate to a certified professional.
- [Property Management Teams](https://moldtraining.us/#pricing): 4 hours, $229.99/seat. Operational-level course for property managers, maintenance staff, and leasing teams — mold fundamentals, moisture sources and building vulnerabilities, prevention and maintenance, recognizing and assessing mold growth, remediation basics and safe response, OSHA & EPA guidelines, and tenant communication/documentation.
- [Mold Inspector Certification](https://moldtraining.us/#pricing): 6 hours, $329.99/seat. Professional-level course aligned with IAC2 Standards of Practice — mold biology and building science, IAC2 standards, conducting visual inspections, moisture meters and sampling techniques, interpreting lab results, writing defensible inspection reports, remediation oversight and clearance testing, and regulatory/legal considerations.

## Resources

- [FAQ & Resource Library](https://moldtraining.us/frequently-asked-questions/): Answers on identifying and assessing mold, tenant complaints and resolution, moisture sources and prevention, remediation and vendor management, documentation and liability, and training next steps.
- [State-by-State Mold Law Quick Reference](https://moldtraining.us/frequently-asked-questions/#state-law): Orientation summary of mold and landlord-tenant habitability law for all 50 states plus Washington, D.C. (general guidance only, not legal advice).

## Other Formats

- [HAZWOPER-OSHA.com course listing](https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/mold-awareness-prevention-and-remediation-training-for-property-management-teams): SCORM, Virtual Instructor-Led, and In-Person training options.
- [Industrial Certified Training, LLC](https://ictraining.us/): Parent company, specializing in OSHA, EPA, and IAC2 training.
